status: Frozen before observing v2 transformed target outputs; adaptively motivated by the v1 support-only failure
purpose: A separately registered support amendment testing normalized masked Gaussian moments on the same reused published rows; no independent validation, ink-truth, false-positive-rate, generalization or unread-scroll claim

prior_v1.observed_outcome: Complete rectangular-kernel support excluded both original published rows entirely and all matched/shuffle centres; no transformed target recovery outcome was observed
prior_v1.relationship: v1 remains unchanged and unassessable. v2 is an adaptive, separately registered feasibility pilot, not an independent confirmatory replicate.

source_representation: Released TRACE times mean-A-hn model score, not raw CT or a new independent detector
source_validity_semantics: CT display layer20>0 AND finite released claim score; matched cases additionally require finite released shuffle score. These are tissue/model-support proxies, not audited physical acquisition coverage. Invalid stored zeroes remain invalid.
threshold_rationale: 0.95 is a prospectively fixed resource/design choice, not an optimized or calibrated threshold. It bounds retained-kernel renormalization to approximately 1/0.95; it does not bound standardized-score error or certify physical coverage.
gaussian_operator: Unchanged scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter with sigma=1.5mm/effective_work_spacing, truncate=3, mode=constant, cval=0. Each full discrete truncated kernel sums to one. Float32 filtering is retained from v1.
common_support: Let M be the unchanged conservative work_grid observed-centre mask and C=Gaussian(M). Rank exactly S=M AND (C>=0.95). Exterior-array locations and internal missing samples contribute zero validity weight. Do not divide C by an in-bounds-only kernel or reflect/wrap/extend the boundary. Unobserved centres never become eligible through neighbouring data.
native_centre_requirement: Keep the existing work_grid requirement that area-averaged native validity fraction is >=1-1e-6. A mixed or unobserved work centre remains excluded even when its neighbours have adequate Gaussian mass.
local_statistics: Use the original observed-centre mask M, not the final comparison mask S, for both weighted moments: mean=Gaussian(M*score)/C; second=Gaussian(M*score**2)/C; variance=max(second-mean**2,0). Invalid scores are explicitly replaced by storage zero before multiplication/filtering. Normalize moments only where C>0; score/rank/save valid transformed samples only on S.
global_statistics_support: Mean and population standard deviation on the same final S used by all three ranked views
source_row_metric: Unchanged v1 mapping: rasterize proposals on the work grid; count each original source row/box pixel through its work-cell centre mapping. Report both supported-sample denominators and full-original-source denominators explicitly. Every view of one input uses the identical S and target denominators. The inherited gate uses conditional coverage on supported source samples, NOT coverage of the full original row.

coverage_metric_semantics.conditional_centreline_fraction: Covered supported original centreline pixels / supported original centreline pixels; null when no centreline support exists
coverage_metric_semantics.conditional_box_fraction: Covered supported original box pixels / supported original box pixels; null when no box support exists
coverage_metric_semantics.observed_covered_fraction_of_full_source: Covered supported original centreline pixels / all original centreline pixels; descriptive known-supported coverage, not a claim that unsupported pixels contain no signal
Covered supported original box pixels / all original box pixels; descriptive known-supported coverage, not an ink segmentation
coverage_metric_semantics.first_half_supported_centreline_rank: First individual proposal covering >=50% of supported original centreline samples; inherited continuation-gate metric
coverage_metric_semantics.first_half_full_source_centreline_rank: First individual proposal whose supported covered pixels constitute >=50% of the full original centreline; descriptive only, NOT added to the inherited gate
coverage_metric_semantics.gate_limitation: The unchanged gate requires >=50% original centreline support and >=50% conditional coverage. Together these can represent only 25% of the full original row. Strong-row top-five preservation is also conditional on the same support. Full-source fractions are reported separately and do not silently replace the v1 gate.

line_ranker: Unchanged line_review.Config defaults, thresholds 0.25/0.5/0.75; transformed views declared display_signal with no probability or calibration claim
threshold_interpretation: For standardized views, the fixed thresholds correspond to standardized contrasts 1,2,3; they do not inherit any previous null calibration

localization_continuation_gate.zero_baseline_count_convention: Use max(1, baseline_count) only in the proposal-explosion check; zero is retained in the report

process_control: Retain all three cases. Matched claim and depth shuffle use the same frozen source mask and therefore the same derived comparison mask. Inadequate target support remains unassessable and can prevent an operational gate. A depth shuffle is an intervention, not a population of certified blank papyrus.
operational_gate: Not established by one already inspected published source, even if the localization continuation gate passes; requires independent positive and artifact controls with adequate support
excluded: editing or replacing the v1 experiment
normalizing coverage by the in-bounds kernel
changing the Gaussian scale after outcomes
treating proxy coverage as physical acquisition coverage
narrow blank strip as approval control
343 display overlay as same-scale score control
unlabelled pixels treated as certified negatives
using any earlier differently masked proposal count as the v2 raw baseline
background: CFAR-inspired local standardization only. Missingness can be structured and correlated with cracks or model coverage, and normalization can enhance artifact rims. No calibrated CFAR guarantee.
